A code which represents a particular optimization result and a reason for markdown pricing. Explains whether the optimizer was run or not for the plan version, if optimization was a success or failure and the reason for its failure. Valid codes are:
'OPTIMIZER_STR_ACHIEVED': Optimizer run successful. Optimal discount solution satisfies target STR requirement and achieves the highest gate sales it could.
'LOW_PRICE': Optimizer not run. Rule based approach - group price meets the low price criteria. Applied the low price rule directly without optimization.
'OPTIMIZER_STR_NOT_ACHIEVED_STORE_INVENTORY': Optimizer run failed. Optimal discount solution DOES NOT satisfy target STR requirement due to the remaining store inventory.
'OPTIMIZER_STR_NOT_ACHIEVED_UPSTREAM_INVENTORY': Optimizer run failed. Optimal discount solution DOES NOT satisfy target STR requirement due to the remaining upstream inventory.
'INFEASIBLE_DEFAULT_MARKDOWN': Optimization is infeasible. Any feasible markdown price does not lie within minimum and maximum price bounds. Applied default markdown.
'BUDGET_INFEASIBLE_MIN_MARKDOWN': Optimization is infeasible. Markdown spend does not stay witihn the budget required. Applied minimum markdown.
'MISSING_ELASTICITY_MIN_MARKDOWN': Optimizer not run. Rule based approach - elasticity is missing. Applied minimum markdown directly without optimization.
'ZERO_OR_MISSING_AVG_DAILY_SALE_MIN_MARKDOWN': Optimizer not run. Rule based approach - average daily sales data is either zero or missing. Applied minimum markdown directly without optimization.
 'ZERO_OR_MISSING_PROJECTED_INVENTORY_MIN_MARKDOWN': Optimizer not run. Rule based approach - projected start inventory at gate is either zero or missing. Applied minimum markdown directly without optimization.
'MARKDOWN_NOT_NEEDED': Optimizer not run. Markdown is not mandatory. Target STR achieved without any markdown.
